title: SPLiT-seq
scope: Rosenberg 2018 SPLiT-seq implementation, at the scope of the assigned Illumina SPLiT-seq row: three rounds of intracellular split-pool indexing followed by separately indexed PCR sublibraries. Three drawn wells/tubes per round are representative parallel routes, not a claim of three reactions in the experimental implementation. The adjacent sci-RNA-Seq row and standalone chemical legend are outside the target workflow. The depicted endpoint is amplified cDNA ready for subsequent library preparation; sequencing and computational reconstruction are interpreted interfaces, not additional depicted Operations.

method_scopes.rationale: All listed Operations belong to the upper SPLiT-seq workflow and the Rosenberg 2018 four-round combinatorial implementation. The figure draws three representative wells or tubes per round, retained as separate local operations until a visible pooling junction. The paper supports fixed cells or nuclei; this graph uses the fixed-cell depiction rather than adding a separate nucleus workflow. The Single cell / PolyA RNA inset establishes target identity, not a depicted RNA-isolation route. The nearby sci-RNA-Seq workflow is not an alternative under this assigned row. Biotin is assigned here because the third-barcode caption explicitly states its conjugation; its standalone chemical legend is not a separate reaction.
